description: This source file contains the implementation of a builder class for creating responses and events related to the deletion of a feature within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides methods to generate success responses, error responses for inaccessible or non-modifiable features, and event objects to signal feature deletion.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing the builder interface to create command responses and events for deleting a feature, with internal factory classes for response and event creation.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the builder with the specified delete feature command.

methods.name: doCreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a command response based on the provided response factory.

methods.name: doCreateEvent
methods.description: Creates an event object based on the provided event factory.
